name: 73-heading-unit-one-line
description: A currency statement lies on one line, which holds no tab. A statement that runs onto a line with a tab is none, so it gives no unit (spec 0.10, #315). AUD has no form in the unit table, so it is at every token. Since spec 0.11, a unit item that holds its name repeats the unit and passes, as the candidate with no unit item passes (#423).
